G0341.definition: ἀνα-καινόω, -ῶ; = ἀνακαινίζω (cf. MM, VGT, see word), ; to make new: 2Co.4:16, Col.3:10 (see Cremer, 323).†; (AS)

G0391.definition: ἀνα-στροφή, -ῆς, ἡ ; (ἀναστρέφομαι)  ; 1. a turning down or back, a wheeling about (Soph., Thuc., al.). ; 2. In late writers (Polyb., al.; see: ἀναστρέφω, and cf. Hort on Jas.3:13; MM, VGT, see word), manner of life, behaviour, conduct: Gal.1:13, Eph.4:22, 1Ti.4:12, Heb.13:7, Jas.3:13, 1Pe.1:15 1:18 2:12 3:1-2 3:16, 2Pe.2:7 3:11.†; (AS)

G0365.definition: ἀνα-νεόω, -ῶ; (νέος),  ; to renew: pass., Eph.4:23 (see Cremer, 428; MM, VGT, see word)†; (AS)

G0330.definition: ἀνα-θάλλω; (θάλλω, to flourish),  ; to revive: Php.4:10 (of MM, VGT, see word).†; (AS)

G0362.definition: ἀνα-μένω; to await "one whose coming is expected, perhaps with the added idea of patience and confidence" with accusative, 1Th.1:10 (see M, Th., in l; MM, VGT, see word).†; (AS)

G0329.definition: ἀνα-ζωπυργέω, -ῶ; (ζωός, πῦρ),  ; to kindle afresh: metaphorically, 2Ti.1:6 (for vernac. exx., see MM, VGT, see word).†; (AS)

G0366.definition: ἀνα-νήφω ; to return to soberness: metaphorically, 2Ti.2:26 (of. ἐκνήφω).†; (AS)

G0388.definition: ἀνα-σταυρόω ; 1. to impale (Hdt.). ; 2. to raise on a cross, crucify (Polyb., al.). ; 3. to crucify again: Heb.6:6 (see Westc., in l).†; (AS)

G0357.definition: ἀνα-λογίζομαι; to consider: Heb.12:3 (MM, VGT, see word).†; (AS)

G0313.definition: ἀνα-γεννάω, -ῶ; to beget again: metaphorically, of spiritual birth, 1Pe.1:3 1:23 (cf. Cremer, 147; MM, VGT, see word).†; (AS)

G0328.definition: ἀνα-ζώννυμι; to gird up: figuratively, τ. ὀσφύας τ. διανοίας, 1Pe.1:13.†; (AS)

G0317.definition: adv., ; necessarily or by constraint: opposite to ἑκουσίως, 1Pe.5:2 (rare).†; (AS)
